title: Ravengard's Scourger
summary: +2 morningstar that lets you direct an ally’s melee weapon attack.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 2 Piercing plus Strength. +2 attack rolls. Martial one-handed morningstar, Dippable, 5 ft melee.
fields.Tenacity: Main hand only. Spend a Reaction after a missed melee attack to deal Strength modifier Bludgeoning, minimum 1. It does not apply the missed action’s effects.
fields.Commander’s Strike: Action and Bonus Action, 30 ft, once per Short Rest with this weapon. The selected ally gets Onus of Battle for 3 turns and spends their Reaction on a single melee weapon attack on a subsequent turn. It ends even if that attack misses. The wielder can trigger Extra Attack, the ally’s granted attack cannot.
fields.Acquisition: High Security Vault 5 in the Counting House.
fields.Heartstopper: Action for 1d4 + attack ability modifier Piercing. A failed Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 causes Chest Trauma for 2 turns. It removes one Action, gives Disadvantage on Constitution saves, and ends when healed. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action, normal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2. Failure Dazes for 2 turns, removing Dexterity AC bonus, giving Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and blocking spending Reaction points. Help clears it. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Base value: 310 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
